sections.title: Advanced Concept – Level 2
sections.content: Level 2 involves multi-step problems where principal, rate, or time may vary, and questions may include successive CI, SI+CI mixes, or fractional periods. These require careful stepwise calculation.

sections.title: Simple Interest (SI) – Advanced
sections.content:
SI = (P × R × T)/100
• Rearrange formula to find unknown principal, rate, or time.
• Multi-step problems may involve multiple periods with different principals or rates.

sections.title: Compound Interest (CI) – Advanced
sections.content:
CI = P × ((1 + R/100)^T - 1)
• Principal grows every year; compounding frequency must be considered (annual, half-yearly, quarterly).
• Successive transactions require using the updated principal.

sections.title: Amount Calculation
sections.content:
Amount = Principal + Interest
• For fractional periods, convert months/days to years.
• Stepwise calculation: calculate intermediate amounts after each period.

sections.title: Mixed SI & CI
sections.content: Some problems may have SI for one period and CI for another, or multiple items with different interest types. Always update principal after each period.

sections.title: Time/Rate Unknown Problems
sections.content:
• Use algebra to solve unknown rate or time.
• Total interest and principal may be given.
• Convert fractional time to decimals before calculation.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
• Ignoring fractional periods
• Forgetting to add CI to principal for next year
• Incorrect sequence for mixed SI+CI
• Forgetting to update principal for successive years

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content:
• SI = P × R × T /100
• CI = P × ((1+R/100)^T -1)
• Amount = Principal + Interest
• Always calculate stepwise for multi-step, successive, or mixed problems
• Convert fractional time to decimal

tricks.title: Successive CI Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Add first year’s CI to principal for the next year’s calculation.
tricks.example: ₹1000, 10% CI 2 years: Year1 CI=100 → new P=1100 → Year2 CI=110 → Total CI=210

tricks.title: Fractional Time Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Multiply interest by fraction of year: months/12 or days/365.

tricks.title: Half-Yearly Compounding
tricks.explanation: Adjust rate and periods: Half-yearly → R/2, T×2
tricks.example: 10% annual CI, 1 year half-yearly: Amount = P × (1 + 5/100)^2

tricks.title: Mixed SI + CI Trick
tricks.explanation: Update principal after each transaction before calculating the next interest.
tricks.example: ₹1000, 10% CI + 5% SI: Year1 CI=100 → new P=1100 → next SI 5%=55

tricks.title: Unknown Rate/Time Trick
tricks.explanation: Use total SI or CI formula algebraically to find unknown rate or time.

tricks.title: Multi-Item Investment Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Calculate interest for each item separately, then sum for total interest.

tricks.title: Successive Approximation
tricks.explanation: Estimate CI using SI for small rates/short periods to check answer.
